disposition_reason: Cd, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb and Zn were measured in moss gametophytes and unwashed European blueberry (Vaccinium myrtillus) LEAVES as bioindicators of expressway traffic; no berries or other foods were analyzed.

study.design: roadside biomonitoring transects (0-110 m from the S7 expressway) in pine and fir stands
study.origin: forest plots along the S7 expressway, Poland
study.method: unwashed, air-dried, ground; HNO3 mineralization; ICP-OES (iCAP 6000)
study.qa: triplicate determinations; CRM023-050 Trace Metals Sandy Loam 7, recovery acceptance 80-120%

unresolved: Paper title says 'Blueberry' but the analyzed blueberry material is leaves (Section 2.2), so there are no fruit findings.
Leaf and moss values (Tables 1-3, Figures 5-7) are biomonitoring data and are not recorded as food findings.
